g.text: Paired seed effects | five additional seeds only

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #333333

g.text: Separately trained endpoints at 3,200 updates | fixed nested 128/256-Case cohorts
Exploratory follow-up on an already observed development cohort; Case-to-patient mapping unverified; no clinical validation.
Nested fixed 128/256 training Cases; 3,200 updates each, but 50/25 sampled views per Case and different view/order trajectories.
Frozen features; no augmentation; terminal-only supervision; four steps use more compute. Means are not ensembles; sample SD is not a CI.
Fixed final epochs (128: 50; 256: 25), no best-epoch selection. Dice: 224 x 224 letterbox valid pixels.
Primary replication: only five additional seeds; original three are excluded from these figures.
